answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused price movement and cannot meet the mandated 18% reduction, while the low-cost vendor’s quote does. Verify the prior low-cost-vendor record because its reported quick onboarding and accurate invoicing are relevant but do not establish delivery performance under the current 94%-utilization/no-buffer condition. Any switch should be guarded until capacity, lead-time, quality, and continuity commitments are validated; do not infer delivery reliability from price or invoicing history alone.
